description: The accessibility capabilities each design-render target declares, and the theme token pairs each target paints. design-verify grades a required capability as passed or failed and reports an unsupported one as unsupported with its reason, never as passed. The declaration is fixed per target; it is never tuned per run or per brand. references/design-verify.md is normative.

reading-order.mechanism: Units are sections in composition order, and each unit's slots follow its pattern's reading order in the DOM.

alt-descriptions.mechanism: Every figure is an svg with role=img, named by aria-labelledby pointing at its claim and described by aria-describedby pointing at its text alternative: the data table for a chart, the entity list for a system.

contrast.mechanism: WCAG 2.1 AA over the painted token pairs, computed from the brand's resolved colour tokens: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for graphics a reader needs.

non-color.mechanism: Every chart point carries its own label and value as text, and every relationship its kind as text; no series, side or relationship is told apart by colour alone.

reading-order.mechanism: Slides follow composition order, and each slide's copy shapes follow its pattern's reading order in the shape tree, which is the order assistive technology reads them in.

alt-descriptions.mechanism: Every chart graphic frame and every picture carries a non-empty cNvPr descr, the variant's purpose from the pattern library; a system's entities are native text node shapes, so its entity list is the slide's own text.

contrast.mechanism: WCAG 2.1 AA over the painted token pairs, computed from the brand's resolved colour tokens: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for graphics a reader needs.

non-color.mechanism: Every chart point carries its own label and value as native text on its row, and every relationship connector a native kind label.

slide-titles.reason: The writer places every headline in a named text shape, never in a title placeholder, so assistive technology does not announce a slide title and the application's outline view shows none.
